# FLX-3627: a consumer query or view is larger than the engine reads

**Family:** seam/conformance (the 3000 band)

A text holds at most 20,000 tokens and brackets nested at most 64 deep, both counted on sqlglot's tokens before the parser runs, and its parsed tree at most 10,000 nodes and 64 levels. A long chain of AND or OR nests one level per term: group the terms in brackets or use IN. The columns its stars become and the projections its positional GROUP BY keys copy add at most 100,000 nodes between them, counted before sqlglot writes any of them out: name the columns instead of repeating a star, and group by the expressions. The message names the limit that was passed.

## Look it up offline

```console
$ fluxsim explain FLX-3627
```
